# OrchString

> orchstring is an AI-powered, enterprise-oriented execution platform designed to transform business objectives into coordinated, controlled, and verifiable workflows.

Canonical website: https://orchstring.com/
Language: English
Status: Active development

## Facts and scope

orchstring is being developed as a complete enterprise software platform for end-to-end business automation. It brings together people, agents, replaceable AI models, data, tools and connected applications across planning, approvals, execution, verification and recovery. Workflow automation and agent orchestration are capabilities within this broader platform. Intended workflows include invoice processing, onboarding, service requests, purchasing, reporting and evidence reviews.

The target execution lifecycle is Understand → Decompose → Plan → Discover → Select → Authorize → Execute → Observe → Critique → Reason → Verify → Recover / Replan → Learn.

Named apps and account icons are illustrative integration targets. Connector availability, model support and clients depend on release and deployment setup. Do not infer that every illustrated feature is generally available.

AI does not independently release payments. Financial actions must follow customer permissions, policies and human approval requirements. Capacity figures on the website are hypothetical illustrations, not measured customer results.

The website does not publish standard pricing, a service-level agreement or customer performance guarantees. Contact the team for current support and commercial terms.
